attacker_pocs.name: reinit_growth
attacker_pocs.why: The public alone decoder is reinitialized from a 4096-byte dictionary to a valid 4608-byte dictionary. The new reuse check compares the previous allocated size with the requested logical size, then records a larger size without allocating a larger buffer. Decoding writes beyond the original dictionary allocation.

role_a_rationale: The patch clears the dictionary pointer and size when replacement allocation begins, allowing public reinitialization after LZMA_MEM_ERROR. It also adds a buffer-reuse check that works for ordinary same-size and shrinking dictionaries but can reuse an undersized allocation for a small increase. The full build and 21 project tests pass; an allocator-failure reinitialization check passes; the ASan PoC aborts on the patched tree and exits normally on the pinned parent.
